body:
PCP and Xanex
About 10:00 PM (not very late for me): One time I had a little bit of angeldust (PCP laced marijuana). I decided that since I only had enough for a buzz I would steal some of my mothers Xanex (I *think* they were 1.5 mg tablets). I smoked the PCP in a relaxed state of mind out of my soda-can bowl. I was high enough to feel a little numb but not enough to get the delerium I usually have. So I was sitting in my room feeling like I was both drunk and stoned. I popped the Xanex and within seconds my high dissipated and was replaced by a headache.
It seems to be possible that Xanex may stop a PCP high which is handy if one isfreaking out and having a bad trip. But it is also possible that it will kill me or something.
I was taking no other prescription or OTC drugs at the time.
